data.body: `LocalDurableTestRunner` rebuilds a supplied `DurableConfig` by passing its effective plugin list through `DurableConfig.builder()` again. When `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS` selects one OTel view, that list already contains the dynamically created view; rebuilding discovers another instance, and this validation rejects the otherwise valid single-view configuration. Preserve the original explicit registrations or provide a config-copy path that skips dynamic discovery, and add a runner test using an actually environment-selected single view.
